title: Collatz: direct least-source descent, exact-grade lifts and paired closure
body:
## The closing implication remains open

The outstanding ordinary implication is $36k+8\in C\Rightarrow72k+17\in C$, equivalently $u\in C\Rightarrow9u+2\in C$ for $u=9k+2$, where $C$ is the basin of 1. This continuation puts three GPT-6.2 Astra streams directly on the given parent's certificate, original-source descent and prescribed paired renewal. No universal successful selector or convergence proof was obtained.

## Direct result at the least counterexample

Write $(4u+1)/9=3^h w$, $3\nmid w$, and $B(u)=8\,2^h w-1$. The new Lean identity proves that this actual positive integer reaches the actual child $9u+2$.

The full pinned PR193 table implies that a least positive counterexample $N$, if one exists, supplies a failed transfer with
$$
N\le B(u)\le JN,\qquad J=\frac{20970919}{122875}<171.
$$
The required contradiction therefore follows from an ordinary child-component representative strictly below $B(u)/J$. Both independent reviewers replayed the 291-leaf table and recovered its exact extra-edge input bound.

This discharges the entire formerly problematic family $u=2^{6j+1}$ as a least-counterexample witness. For $j\ge10$, the actual child endpoint $9\cdot27^j+1$ lies below $B(u)/171$; the ten earlier children reach 1 directly. A fixed-reference Diophantine extension handles sufficiently deep dyadic translates.

The arbitrary-parent step remains unproved. A parent with one odd input can force the child to grow throughout its stopping time. An ordinary-path reselection reaches adjacent Mersenne inputs with the smaller one known to converge, but no decreasing measure or successful next certificate was established.

## Earlier work retained in this continuation

The [global-budget packet](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b72cea3bcd5aa51aba8df6f5e63bc1c473e9523b/research/astra-global-budget-20261124/README.md) records:

- A weighted-duration decomposition covering all scale changes; its nonnegative residual sum still has no original-source bound.
- An exact triadic certificate decoder and a fixed-source S-unit estimate. For exponentially bounded distinct lifts with a bounded odd tail, a moving terminal $Z$ satisfies $\liminf \log Z/r\ge(\log3)/2$, with a sharp one-even-step example.
- Genuine completed paired returns to a prescribed $(q,5q)$, with both clocks and odd counts retained. The present import cost prevents a near-linear full-height estimate.
- Source-qualified exact-grade convergent lifts at every sufficiently deep binary approximation to one fixed input. Their later meeting does not include the original input.
- Source-qualified nearly full inverse multiplicity at every prescribed first endpoint, with a companion state chosen anew at each depth. The fixed finite companion menu needed for the common suffix remains unproved.

The final intake incorporates the specific claims at refreshed PR193, PR200, PR201 and PR203 heads, with [full source pins and dependency boundaries](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/b72cea3bcd5aa51aba8df6f5e63bc1c473e9523b/research/astra-global-budget-20261124/SOURCES.json). Analytic floors remain stated inputs; no full independent rebuild of those external proofs is claimed.

All eighteen named declarations use only standard Lean axioms. New project objects were compiled afresh; pinned prebuilt dependencies were reused. The four Python pairs passed with identical output under ordinary Python and `-O`, and no disappearing `assert` checks. The required structural validator passed; this is not mathematical verification.
